label: target-credential-reencrypt
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=<WORKDIR>/E4/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i <WORKDIR>/E4/id_ed25519 -p 22145 root@127.0.0.1 bash -s
script:
set -euxo pipefail
cp /root/e4/credential-matrix/source.secret /root/e4/credential-matrix/source-source/credential.secret
unshare --mount /bin/bash -c 'mount --make-rprivate /; mount --bind /root/e4/credential-matrix/source-source /var/lib/systemd; mount --bind /root/e4/credential-matrix/source.id /etc/machine-id; systemd-creds decrypt --name=e4-secret /srv/e4/credential.cred -' | systemd-creds encrypt --with-key=host --name=e4-secret - /srv/e4/rekeyed.cred
systemd-creds decrypt --name=e4-secret /srv/e4/rekeyed.cred -
systemd-run --unit=e4-secret-consumer --wait --pipe -p LoadCredentialEncrypted=e4-secret:/srv/e4/rekeyed.cred /bin/sh -c 'cat "$CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/e4-secret"'
cat /etc/machine-id
sha256sum /var/lib/systemd/credential.secret /srv/e4/rekeyed.cred
